fenced_json.notes: ARCH-001 is closed. Every r-6 amendment now has (Active, r-6) bullets for the points you named. ADR-SAG-0013 (line 871) records the envelope ids (correlation_id is the session id, request_id is the answer id) and the Warn level on send_outcome=failed. These match obs.rs:216-221 and 239-245. ADR-SAG-0016 (line 967) records the same mapping and notes that ids are built through serde. ADR-SAG-0008 (line 268) records the sweep grace, which is TTL plus one TTL. ADR-SAG-0031 Wiring (lines 1771-1774) records the error-path flush note: the log is still flushed on error, and a flush failure is appended once to the error detail with the code unchanged. I did not check the sweep grace or the error-path flush against the code, since your request limited the code check to obs.rs. The envelope_id! debug_assert macro is a local helper. It changes no contract, adds no dependency, and holds no mutex across an await, so it creates no ADR delta.
